site_name: International Quarter London (Iql) North, Bounded By Penny Brookes Street To The North, Celebration Avenue To The West,, International Way To The South And Montfichet Road To The East, Stratford, London
description: Full Planning Application for the construction of 6 buildings ranging from 20 to 32 storeys (including basement) in height (up to 115.6m AOD) providing 672 residential (Use Class C3), 29,285sqm GIA of purpose-builtstudent accommodation (Sui Generis) (909 student bedspaces), 808sqm community floorspace (Use Class F2), 8,186sqm flexible commercial business and services (Use Class E), drinking establishments (Sui Generis), servicing, landscaping, parking and other associated works (Revised Description). The revised submission is accompanied by an Environmental Statement (ES) Addendum and updated ES Volume 3, Appendix: Daylight, Sunlight, Overshadowing and Solar Glare including drawings and documents have been submitted.
